name: MultipleDebtTypes
description: Represents a class to specify multiple credit debt types alongside a conditional 'any' or 'all' qualifier.

condition.description: An enumerated attribute, to qualify whether All or Any debt type applies.

debtType.description: The type of debt, e.g. long term debt, deposit, ... FpML doesn't specific a scheme value, hence no enumeration is specified as part of the CDM. At least two debt types much be specified.
